tools.name: search_stations
tools.description: Search for Swiss public transport stations/stops by name or coordinates

tools.name: get_connections
tools.description: Get train/bus connections between two Swiss locations

isArrivalTime.description: True if time is arrival time

tools.name: get_departures
tools.description: Get live departures from a Swiss transport station

tools.name: get_arrivals
tools.description: Get live arrivals at a Swiss transport station

tools.name: get_nearby_stations
tools.description: Find Swiss public transport stations near given coordinates

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get current weather conditions at a Swiss MeteoSwiss station (e.g. BER=Bern, ZUE=Zürich, LUG=Lugano)

station.description: Station code (e.g. BER, ZUE, LUG, GVE, SMA)

tools.name: list_weather_stations
tools.description: List all available MeteoSwiss weather stations in Switzerland

tools.name: get_weather_history
tools.description: Get historical weather data for a Swiss station

tools.name: get_water_level
tools.description: Get current river or lake water level and temperature at a Swiss hydrological station

station.description: Hydro station ID (e.g. 2135 for Aare/Bern, 2243 for Rhine/Basel)

tools.name: list_hydro_stations
tools.description: List all available BAFU hydrological monitoring stations (rivers and lakes) in Switzerland

tools.name: get_water_history
tools.description: Get historical river/lake water level data for a Swiss hydrological station

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Convert a Swiss address or place name to coordinates (swisstopo)

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Convert coordinates to a Swiss address (swisstopo)

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Search Swiss place names, localities, mountains, and geographic features

tools.name: get_solar_potential
tools.description: Get rooftop solar energy potential for a location in Switzerland

tools.name: identify_location
tools.description: Identify geographic features and data layers at a specific Swiss location

tools.name: get_municipality
tools.description: Get information about a Swiss municipality by name

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search Swiss company registry (ZEFIX) by name, canton, or legal form

name.description: Company name or partial name to search

canton.description: Canton abbreviation (e.g. ZH, BE, GE, ZG)

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get full details of a Swiss company by its ZEFIX internal ID (ehraid). Use search_companies first to find the ehraid — it is returned in company search results.

ehraid.description: Company internal ZEFIX ID (ehraid integer, e.g. 119283). Returned by search_companies.

tools.name: search_companies_by_address
tools.description: Search Swiss companies registered at a specific address or locality

tools.name: list_cantons
tools.description: List all Swiss cantons with their codes

tools.name: list_legal_forms
tools.description: List all Swiss company legal forms (AG, GmbH, etc.)

tools.name: get_public_holidays
tools.description: Get Swiss public holidays for a given year, optionally filtered by canton (e.g. ZH, BE, GE). Returns national and canton-specific holidays.

canton.description: Two-letter canton code (e.g. ZH, BE, GE, BS, TI). If omitted, returns all Swiss holidays.

tools.name: get_school_holidays
tools.description: Get Swiss school holidays for a given year, optionally filtered by canton. Returns holiday periods (start/end dates) by canton.

canton.description: Two-letter canton code (e.g. ZH, BE, GE, BS, TI). If omitted, returns school holidays for all cantons.

tools.name: is_holiday_today
tools.description: Check whether today is a Swiss public holiday, optionally for a specific canton. Returns the holiday name if it is one.

canton.description: Two-letter canton code (e.g. ZH, BE, GE). If omitted, checks nationwide holidays only.

tools.name: search_parliament_business
tools.description: Search Swiss Parliament political affairs — bills, motions, interpellations, postulates, questions, and initiatives. Uses OpenParlData.ch full-text search across the Federal Assembly (Bundesversammlung).

tools.name: get_parliament_members
tools.description: List current or past Swiss Parliament members (National Council and Council of States). Filter by canton or party.

canton.description: Canton name in German to filter by (e.g. 'Zürich', 'Bern', 'Genf', 'Waadt')

party.description: Party name or abbreviation to search (e.g. 'SVP', 'SP', 'FDP', 'Grüne', 'Mitte')

tools.name: get_parliament_votes
tools.description: Get voting results for a specific parliamentary affair (Geschäft). Returns all recorded votes for the given affair ID from OpenParlData.

affair_id.description: OpenParlData affair ID (get from search_parliament_business results)

tools.name: get_session_schedule
tools.description: Get upcoming and recent Swiss parliament sessions (Sessionen). Shows session names, dates and types.

limit.description: Number of sessions to return (default: 5, max: 20)

tools.name: search_parliament_speeches
tools.description: Get debate speeches and contributions for a specific parliamentary affair. Returns speaker info and speech details.

affair_id.description: OpenParlData affair ID (get from search_parliament_business results)

tools.name: get_politician_interests
tools.description: Get declared interests and mandates of a Swiss parliament member — board memberships, consulting roles, organizations.

person_id.description: OpenParlData person ID (get from get_parliament_members results)

tools.name: search_cantonal_affairs
tools.description: Search political affairs across Swiss cantonal parliaments (Kantonsräte). Covers all 26 cantons via OpenParlData.

canton.description: Canton abbreviation: ZH, BE, LU, UR, SZ, OW, NW, GL, ZG, FR, SO, BS, BL, SH, AR, AI, SG, GR, AG, TG, TI, VD, VS, NE, GE, JU

tools.name: get_parliamentary_documents
tools.description: Get official documents for a parliamentary affair — reports, committee opinions, federal council statements.

affair_id.description: OpenParlData affair ID (get from search_parliament_business results)

tools.name: get_committee_meetings
tools.description: Get Swiss parliament committee/commission meeting schedule. Optionally filter by committee group ID.

group_id.description: Committee group ID to filter (optional — omit for all committees)

tools.name: get_avalanche_bulletin
tools.description: Get the current Swiss avalanche danger bulletin from SLF (WSL Institute for Snow and Avalanche Research). Returns current bulletin URLs, danger level descriptions, and links to the interactive map. The bulletin is published daily at ~08:00 and updated at ~17:00 Swiss time (October–May).

region.description: Optional region ID (e.g. CH-9 for Central Graubünden) or region name. Use list_avalanche_regions to see all options. If omitted, returns national overview.

language.description: Language for bulletin links: de (German), en (English), fr (French), it (Italian). Default: en

tools.name: list_avalanche_regions
tools.description: List all Swiss avalanche warning regions as defined by SLF/EAWS. Returns region IDs, names, cantons, and typical elevations. Use region IDs with get_avalanche_bulletin.

canton.description: Filter regions by canton abbreviation (e.g. GR, VS, BE). Optional.

tools.name: list_air_quality_stations
tools.description: List all official Swiss NABEL (Nationales Beobachtungsnetz für Luftfremdstoffe) air quality monitoring stations operated by BAFU/EMPA. Returns station codes, names, cantons, coordinates, and environment types.

tools.name: get_air_quality
tools.description: Get information about a Swiss NABEL air quality monitoring station, including location, environment type, Swiss legal limits (LRV), and a direct link to the BAFU live data portal. Use station codes from list_air_quality_stations (e.g. BER=Bern, ZUE=Zürich, LUG=Lugano).

station.description: NABEL station code (e.g. BER, ZUE, LUG, BAS, DAV). Use list_air_quality_stations for all codes.

tools.name: lookup_postcode
tools.description: Look up a Swiss postcode (PLZ) to get locality name, canton, and coordinates. Source: Swiss federal geodata (swisstopo).

tools.name: search_postcode
tools.description: Search Swiss postcodes by city or locality name. Returns all PLZ entries matching the name. Source: Swiss federal geodata (swisstopo).

tools.name: list_postcodes_in_canton
tools.description: List all Swiss postcodes (PLZ) in a given canton. Accepts 2-letter canton codes (ZH, BE, GR…) or full names. Source: Swiss federal geodata (swisstopo).

tools.name: track_parcel
tools.description: Generate a Swiss Post parcel tracking URL for a given tracking number. Swiss Post does not provide a public tracking API, so this returns the official tracking page URL to open in a browser.

tracking_number.description: Swiss Post tracking number, e.g. "99.00.123456.12345678" for parcels or "RI 123456789 CH" for registered mail

tools.name: get_electricity_tariff
tools.description: Get Swiss electricity tariff (price in Rappen/kWh) for a municipality from ElCom (Swiss Federal Electricity Commission). Returns total price and price breakdown by component (energy, grid, taxes). Valid years: 2011–2026.

municipality.description: Municipality BFS number (e.g. '261' for Zürich, '351' for Bern, '6621' for Genève). Use search_municipality_energy to find the ID.

category.description: Electricity category. Household: H1–H8 (H4 is default, ~4500 kWh/year). Commercial: C1–C7. Default: H4.

tools.name: compare_electricity_tariffs
tools.description: Compare Swiss electricity tariffs across multiple municipalities side-by-side. Returns prices sorted from cheapest to most expensive. Useful for relocation decisions or cost analysis.

municipalities.description: Array of municipality BFS numbers to compare (e.g. ['261', '351', '6621']). Max 20. Use search_municipality_energy to find IDs.

tools.name: search_municipality_energy
tools.description: Search for Swiss municipality IDs needed for electricity tariff lookup. Returns BFS municipality numbers for use with get_electricity_tariff and compare_electricity_tariffs.

tools.name: get_population
tools.description: Get Swiss population data from the Federal Statistical Office (FSO/BFS). Returns population figures for Switzerland, a canton, or all cantons. Data source: BFS STATPOP (permanent resident population).

canton.description: Canton name or 2-letter code (e.g. 'ZH', 'Zürich', 'Geneva', 'BE'). Omit to get Switzerland total. Use 'all' to list all cantons.

year.description: Year of data (2010–2024). Defaults to latest (2024).

tools.name: search_statistics
tools.description: Search Swiss Federal Statistical Office (BFS/OFS/UST) datasets on opendata.swiss. Returns matching dataset titles, IDs, and descriptions.

tools.name: get_statistic
tools.description: Fetch details and resource links for a specific BFS/OFS dataset by its opendata.swiss identifier. Use search_statistics first to find dataset IDs.

tools.name: list_currencies
tools.description: List all currencies available from the Swiss National Bank (SNB) for CHF exchange rate data. Returns currency codes, names, and regions.

tools.name: get_exchange_rate
tools.description: Get the current CHF exchange rate for a currency from the Swiss National Bank (SNB). Returns the latest monthly average rate and currency details.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. 'EUR', 'USD', 'GBP', 'JPY'). Use list_currencies to see all available codes.

tools.name: get_exchange_rate_history
tools.description: Get historical CHF exchange rates for a currency from the Swiss National Bank (SNB). Returns monthly average rates with optional date filtering. Without date range, returns the most recent 90 months.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. 'EUR', 'USD', 'GBP'). Use list_currencies to see all available codes.

from.description: Start date in YYYY-MM format (e.g. '2020-01'). Optional.

to.description: End date in YYYY-MM format (e.g. '2026-02'). Optional.

tools.name: get_waste_collection
tools.description: Get upcoming waste collection dates for a Zurich city ZIP code. Returns the next scheduled pickups sorted by date. Currently covers Zurich city only (ZIP codes 8001–8099). Powered by OpenERZ (openerz.metaodi.ch).

type.description: Waste type to filter by (e.g. 'cardboard', 'waste', 'paper', 'organic', 'textile', 'special', 'mobile'). If omitted, returns all types.

limit.description: Maximum number of upcoming collection dates to return. Default: 5.

tools.name: list_waste_types
tools.description: List all supported waste collection types for Zurich city. Returns each type with its description and local name. Currently covers Zurich city only (ZIP codes 8001–8099). Powered by OpenERZ (openerz.metaodi.ch).

tools.name: get_waste_calendar
tools.description: Get a full monthly waste collection calendar for a Zurich city ZIP code. Returns all collection events grouped by date for the given month. Currently covers Zurich city only (ZIP codes 8001–8099). Powered by OpenERZ (openerz.metaodi.ch).

month.description: Month number (1–12). Defaults to the current month.

year.description: Year (e.g. 2026). Defaults to the current year.

tools.name: get_swiss_news
tools.description: Get the latest Swiss news headlines from SRF (Schweizer Radio und Fernsehen). Returns top news articles with title, description, link, and publication date.

category.description: News category. "switzerland" = domestic Swiss news (default), "international" = world news, "economy" = business & economy.

limit.description: Number of articles to return (default: 10, max: 50)

tools.name: search_swiss_news
tools.description: Search Swiss news headlines from SRF by keyword. Searches across all available news categories and returns matching articles.

query.description: Search keyword or phrase to find in news articles

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5, max: 20)

tools.name: get_voting_results
tools.description: Get results of Swiss popular votes (Volksabstimmungen) from Basel-Stadt open data. Returns vote title, date, yes/no counts, yes percentage, and eligible voters. Covers national and cantonal votes since 2021.

year.description: Filter by year (e.g. 2024). If omitted, returns most recent votes.

limit.description: Maximum number of votes to return (default: 10, max: 50).

tools.name: search_votes
tools.description: Search Swiss popular votes by keyword in the vote title (e.g. 'Initiative', 'Klimaschutz', 'CO2', 'AHV'). Returns matching votes with yes/no results.

query.description: Search keyword to find in vote titles (German/French/Italian)

tools.name: get_vote_details
tools.description: Get detailed breakdown of a specific Swiss popular vote, including per-district results for Basel-Stadt (Basel city, Riehen, Bettingen, and overseas voters).

vote_title.description: Partial or full vote title to look up (e.g. 'CO2-Gesetz', 'AHV')

tools.name: search_dams
tools.description: Search Swiss dams and reservoirs under federal supervision by name. Searches both dam names and reservoir names. Returns dam type, height, crest length, reservoir volume, purpose, canton, and year built. Data source: Swiss Federal Office of Energy (SFOE) via swisstopo BGDI.

query.description: Dam or reservoir name to search (e.g. 'Grimsel', 'Grande Dixence', 'Mattmark', 'Lac des Dix'). Partial names are supported.

tools.name: get_dams_by_canton
tools.description: List all Swiss dams under federal supervision in a given canton. Returns up to 20 dams with basic details. Data source: Swiss Federal Office of Energy (SFOE) via swisstopo BGDI.

canton.description: Swiss canton 2-letter abbreviation code (e.g. 'VS' for Valais, 'GR' for Graubünden, 'BE' for Bern, 'UR' for Uri, 'TI' for Ticino, 'VD' for Vaud).

tools.name: get_dam_details
tools.description: Get full technical details of a specific Swiss dam by name. Returns all available fields: dam type, height, crest length, crest level, reservoir name, impoundment volume, storage level, purpose, operation dates, federal supervision start, and canton. Data source: Swiss Federal Office of Energy (SFOE) via swisstopo BGDI.

name.description: Dam name (e.g. 'Grande Dixence', 'Spitallamm', 'Mattmark', 'Verzasca'). Use search_dams first if you are unsure of the exact name.

tools.name: get_trail_closures
tools.description: Get current Swiss hiking trail closures and detours from the official ASTRA/Schweizer Wanderwege dataset. Filter by closure reason (e.g. Steinschlag, Bauarbeiten, Hangrutsch) or type (closure, detour). If no parameters are given, returns all active closures. Data source: swisstopo ch.astra.wanderland-sperrungen_umleitungen.

reason.description: Optional search term for closure reason (e.g. 'Steinschlag', 'Bauarbeiten', 'Hangrutsch', 'Hochwasser'). Matches against the reason field (German or English). Case-insensitive partial match.

type.description: Optional: filter by type — 'closure' (Sperrung) or 'detour' (Umleitung). If omitted, returns both.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 20. Max: 100.

tools.name: get_trail_closures_nearby
tools.description: Find Swiss hiking trail closures and detours near a given GPS coordinate. Converts WGS84 coordinates to Swiss LV95 and queries the swisstopo identify endpoint. Returns closures within the specified radius.

radius.description: Search radius in metres. Default: 10000 (10 km). Max: 50000.

tools.name: get_property_price_index
tools.description: Get the Swiss Residential Property Price Index (SWRPI) — official BFS data. Baseline Q4 2019 = 100. Returns quarterly index values tracking Swiss property prices since 2009. Covers all properties, single-family houses, and apartments separately.

type.description: Property type to filter by: "all" (combined index), "houses" (single-family), "apartments" (condominiums/flats). Defaults to "all".

from.description: Start period (inclusive). Format: "2020Q1", "2020-Q1", or just "2020". Defaults to earliest available (2009-Q4).

to.description: End period (inclusive). Format: "2024Q4", "2024-Q4", or just "2024". Defaults to latest available.

tools.name: search_real_estate_data
tools.description: Search opendata.swiss for Swiss real estate and housing datasets. Finds datasets about property prices, rents, housing construction, vacancy rates, and more. Returns dataset names, descriptions, and resource download URLs.

query.description: Search terms in German, French, or English (e.g. "Immobilien", "Miete", "rent", "logement", "Wohnungspreise", "Leerwohnungen").

tools.name: get_rent_index
tools.description: Get the Swiss Consumer Price Index (CPI/LIK), which tracks cost of living including residential rents. Baseline December 1982 = 100. Published monthly by BFS. For property purchase prices, use get_property_price_index instead.

year.description: Filter to a specific year (1983–2025). Omit for latest 24 months.

limit.description: Number of recent monthly data points to return (1–60, default 24). Ignored if year is set.

tools.name: get_traffic_count
tools.description: Get traffic volume at an ASTRA counting station in Switzerland by location name (e.g. 'Gotthard', 'Zürich', 'Genf'). Returns daily and weekday traffic counts, heavy vehicle percentage, and measurement year.

location.description: Station or location name to search (e.g. 'Gotthard', 'Zürich', 'Basel')

tools.name: get_traffic_by_canton
tools.description: List ASTRA traffic counting stations in a Swiss canton. Returns up to 20 stations with traffic data.

tools.name: get_traffic_nearby
tools.description: Find ASTRA traffic counting stations near a geographic coordinate in Switzerland. Returns nearby stations with traffic volume data.

tools.name: get_recent_earthquakes
tools.description: Get recent seismic events in and around Switzerland from the Swiss Seismological Service (SED) at ETH Zürich. Returns earthquakes and optionally quarry blasts, sorted by most recent first.

days.description: Number of past days to search (default: 30, max: 365)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20)

include_blasts.description: Include quarry blasts in results (default: false — earthquakes only)

tools.name: get_earthquake_details
tools.description: Get full details for a specific seismic event by its SED (Swiss Seismological Service) event ID. Use event IDs returned by get_recent_earthquakes or search_earthquakes_by_location.

event_id.description: The SED event ID (e.g. 'smi:ch.ethz.sed/sc25a/Event/2026errxzt'). Obtain from get_recent_earthquakes or search_earthquakes_by_location.

tools.name: search_earthquakes_by_location
tools.description: Search for earthquakes near a geographic location using the Swiss Seismological Service (SED) FDSN API. Useful for finding seismic activity near a Swiss city, landmark, or custom coordinates.

lat.description: Latitude of the center point (decimal degrees, e.g. 46.9 for Bern)

lon.description: Longitude of the center point (decimal degrees, e.g. 7.5 for Bern)

days.description: Number of past days to search (default: 90, max: 365)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20, max: 100)

tools.name: get_snow_conditions
tools.description: Get current snow conditions across Switzerland from SLF (WSL Institute for Snow and Avalanche Research). Returns snow depth and new snow (24h) for IMIS stations, sorted by snow depth. Filter by canton or minimum altitude. Data updated daily.

canton.description: Filter by canton abbreviation (e.g. GR, VS, BE, UR, TI). Optional.

min_altitude.description: Minimum station altitude in metres (e.g. 2000). Optional.

limit.description: Maximum number of stations to return (default: 20, max: 100).

tools.name: list_snow_stations
tools.description: List all SLF snow measurement stations in Switzerland (IMIS automatic stations and manual study plots). Returns station code, name, altitude, canton, and type. Sorted by elevation descending.

canton.description: Filter by canton abbreviation (e.g. GR, VS, BE). Optional.

type.description: Station type: "imis" (automatic) or "study-plot" (manual). Optional — returns both by default.

limit.description: Maximum number of stations to return (default: 20, max: 200).

tools.name: get_snow_measurements
tools.description: Get detailed snow and weather measurements for a specific SLF station. IMIS stations return 30-min data (snow depth, temperature, humidity, wind, radiation). Study plots return daily data (snow depth, new snow, water equivalent). Use list_snow_stations to find station codes.

station_code.description: Station code (e.g. DAV2, WFJ2, 4AO0). Use list_snow_stations to find codes.

type.description: Station type: "imis" (default) or "study-plot". Determines which API endpoint to query.

tools.name: get_pollen_current
tools.description: Get current hourly pollen concentrations at a MeteoSwiss pollen monitoring station. Returns the most recent hours of data for 7 pollen types: Alder, Birch, Hazel, Beech, Ash, Oak, and Grasses. Source: MeteoSwiss.

station.description: Station code (e.g. "PZH" for Zürich, "PBE" for Bern, "PBS" for Basel). Use list_pollen_stations for all codes.

tools.name: get_pollen_daily
tools.description: Get daily pollen concentration averages at a MeteoSwiss pollen monitoring station. Returns daily readings for 7 pollen types over the requested number of days. Source: MeteoSwiss.

station.description: Station code (e.g. "PZH" for Zürich, "PBE" for Bern). Use list_pollen_stations for all codes.

days.description: Number of recent days to return (default: 7, max: 90)

tools.name: list_pollen_stations
tools.description: List all 16 MeteoSwiss automatic pollen monitoring stations in Switzerland. Returns station codes, names, cantons, altitude, and coordinates. Source: MeteoSwiss.

canton.description: Filter by canton abbreviation (e.g. ZH, BE, GE, TI)
